title: CUB equal-budget selective keypoint missingness diagnostic

selection_mechanisms.MCAR: Uniform sampling without replacement within each class and fold-training set.
selection_mechanisms.MAR_X: Weighted sampling without replacement from frozen-image typicality computed using only the fold-training images and class labels.
selection_mechanisms.MNAR_Z: Weighted sampling without replacement from visible-keypoint count and spatial coverage, which are hidden when annotation is missing.
selection_mechanisms.SI_HARD: Deterministic top-two selection by the mean of within-class image-typicality and keypoint-completeness ranks, creating a support hole.

screening.training: Use the frozen PAT-D-260728-001 PrPool stack for exactly 9 epochs, its median selected epoch; classification uses every fold-training image and keypoint BCE uses only selected images.

primary_endpoints: OOF balanced accuracy relative to stored Global
biased-mechanism delta relative to equal-budget MCAR
negative-transfer class rate relative to Global
worst-class recall delta relative to Global

go_no_go.selection_bias_supported_if: At least one of MAR_X, MNAR_Z, or SI_HARD is at least 2 pp below MCAR in OOF balanced accuracy, or raises negative-transfer class rate by at least 0.10.
go_no_go.on_go: Repeat the frozen diagnostic with seeds 7602 and 7603, then compare correction baselines before proposing a new method.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Do not invent a correction result; redesign missingness severity in a separately frozen train-only protocol or retain the positive-Oracle result as replication evidence.
